text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...Dammit. This is brutal...!
I can't... catch my breath... at all... dammit...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Man, Senior GⅠs are just...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you're not hyped enough!
Let's hear it, crowd!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Burn with more passion!
Set your heart ablaze! Eat some simmered fish!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (And yet, why is she... doing something like that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaaahhh!!
I'm so ticked oooooffff!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It pisses me off how dumb she is!
And it pisses me off how strong she is too!
Running around looking so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still, I ain't gonna lose eitheeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaaah~~~~... Jeeez~~~~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I feel more tired than ever before. But...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still, I ain't gonna lose eitheeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I was exhausted and it was tough.
I think I still screamed at the top of my lungs after running though."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, what was next again?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), obviously!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Golshi...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, you're ending your match
with Golshi-chan after just one race?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no way, right?
You said you were gonna beat the living daylights out of me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Com, plete?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ignoring what the idiot just said~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're the idiot here!
That's why I'm gonna surpass you!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's a battle for the strongest, extra rounds are inevitable.
Alright, looking forward to next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah. Wait up!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Jeez, what is up with her?!
choice_data_list: Will you take on the Tenno Sho (Spring) with that?
Will you take on the Tenno Sho (Spring) like that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, obviously!
If I'm gonna do it, I'm going all out!

However, the Tenno Sho (Spring) is a 3,200m
long-distance race. Not only is it a course suited for stayers,
but it also gathers top-tier talent from the Senior Class.
choice_data_list: This could turn into a tough race, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's true, it doesn't matter!
I'm done worrying and thinking about complicated stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"All I gotta do is beat Golshi.
That's all there is to it, right?"
That declaration was so simple and powerful, it was hard to believe how down she had been after the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: You can still get so much stronger.
You can still get so much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course!
I mean—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be a super-duper big Umamusume, after all!
